data.name: Love Bird
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Love Bird, the reality dating show where you are the star. Your job? Win hearts, stir drama, charm the nation—or crash and burn while trying. But it's not just about romance—in the world of reality TV, love comes second to good drama, and the producers are always watching.

Twelve contestants compete for your heart. They remember your name, your heartbreak, your life story. They’re thinking, feeling, scheming—just like you. Talk to them naturally, respond with your voice, and shape the story through how you connect... or clash. Relationships form. Secrets spill. People fall in love, hold grudges, or storm off set. And it's all unfolding in real time, moment by moment. No two play throughs are ever the same.

Create Drama, or Find Love

Underneath the feathers and flirtation lies a ruthless game of viewership, ratings, and network television. It's up to you to keep viewers hooked by stirring up just enough chaos to thrill the producers—without driving your love interests to the brink. Play it too sweet, and you’ll be forgettable. Push too hard, and the whole cast might walk out. Every moment is a high-wire act between heartbreak and headline.

Discover the Mysteries Within

Behind the scenes, not everything is as it seems. Hidden beneath the romance and reality TV tropes is a sprawling network of power plays, secret agendas, and buried truths. The more you connect with contestants and crew, the more cracks you’ll see in the show’s glossy surface. Everyone has something to hide—and if you dig deep enough, you might uncover who’s really pulling the strings.

  • Voice & Dialogue: Speak naturally and use eye contact to influence the world around you.

  • Heart Meter: Woo contestants… or insult them. Your charisma is your power.

  • Fan Meter: Keep ratings high by giving producers what they want: drama.

  • Five-Episode Seasons: Each playthrough lasts a full season (2 to 100 hours) with dramatic "dailies" and cutthroat eliminations.

  • Mind-Reading Testimonials: See what contestants really think in real-time.

  • Dynamic Camera Crew: Cause a scene, and they’ll swarm. Get in with the crew to unlock juicy Easter eggs and hidden storylines.

Whether You Love - Or Hate - Reality TV

Love reality dating shows? Good. Hate it? Even better. This is your chance to step into the spotlight—or turn the whole production on its head. Either way, Love Bird offers you the chance to take center stage and be the mastermind of "reality."

Will you go down as the most beloved star of Love Bird or its most infamous villain? Either way, the cameras are rolling.

Your legacy awaits!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 3, Pro, 2

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes mature themes related to romance, manipulation, and public image. Players may encounter flirtation, suggestive dialogue, alcohol use, emotional conflict, and satirical depictions of reality TV drama. There is no graphic sexual content or violence.
